name: Winline
verdict: Russian bookmaker run by OOO Upravlyayushchaya kompaniya NKS; the largest share (45%) belongs to Andrei Myslivtsev, with the rest held by four private individuals. Nothing found.
note: Ownership claim follows Stavka.TV's dated owner table (1 Oct 2026): Andrei Myslivtsev 45%, Larisa Egorchenko 20%, Robert Yusupov 16%, Eduard Grishkin 15%, Lyalya Yusupova 4%. Discrepancy: Legalbet's owner page names the main owner 'Dmitry Myslivtsev' — first name disagrees with Stavka.TV's 'Andrei'; surname and largest-share statement agree. Private owners; no state stake in the cited sources. Rating note: no link to a state with a record and no human-rights finding against the company itself found; nothing passes METHOD.md.
